brief:
Israeli occupation forces stormed the towns of Qaffin and Zeita north of Tulkarem on Tuesday, according to Shehab Wire. The operation marked the latest in a series of incursions across the northern West Bank region.

The raids coincided with wider military movements across several villages and towns in the Shaarawiya area. Forces conducted operations in multiple locations simultaneously as part of what Israeli authorities characterized as routine security operations.
